1437614329.annotation: Great healing in lane from punching minions. And we upgrade this into Lifestrike. Procs on your 2 as well!

1976391348.annotation: Adds to your burst damage, and the slow is great. We also can upgrade this into Arctic Blast.

3399065363.annotation: Must buy for rotating around the map and ganking other lanes. Builds into Enduring Speed for our Vitality investment spike.

3190916303.annotation: Spirit resist and power steal is amazing. Plus even more melee damage and it procs on your 2. You could get this earlier instead of Torment Pulse.

3074274290.annotation: I think might be really good at the moment. Roam a lot once you get it to build up those stacks.

395867183.annotation: Pretty good. If you're getting 3 1.6k gun items to get your 4.8k spike then this would be one of them usually.

4204808176.annotation: Great against Viscous in lane since it works against Viscous Puddle Punches. Also a very good item against people building melee (Abrams and Billy). Only buy if you can actually parry consistently.

1672893796.annotation: It's really nice for trades and upgrades into lots of good options.

3812615317.annotation: Really great item, great for catching people and for clearing waves in cat form.

2121044373.annotation: You can only really proc this consistently with your ult, Artic Blast, and only after you get Boundless Spirit your bombs.

7409189.annotation: Pretty good for damage, and builds into Boundless Spirit.

343572757.annotation: Anti-heal + more burst damage. If you need to burst carries or need anti-heal this is really useful.

2519598785.annotation: Gives you some much needed damage in the late game with your ult and gloom bombs. Great if you are trying to oneshot their carries.

3731635960.annotation: they got a ton of debuffs

1813726886.annotation: Good against Mina, and other movement focused people.

619484391.annotation: Good item. Very common buy. Silence is very good against many characters.

2533252781.annotation: They doubled the CD on it so it's way worse, still might be good though on Calico. Helps you live much longer. Great with Transcendent CD. You can skip for more damage if you're not dying.

2142980412.annotation: It's fine, good with your burst and the silence is nice.

2081037738.annotation: Upgrades into Escalating Exposure. Spirit shred is extremely useful.

2417568017.annotation: Usually after Arctic Blast. Makes you really tanky and can do a lot of damage if you get into the middle of their team. Boundless is a good alternative here.

3005970438.annotation: This with Scourge is good. You run into the middle of the enemy team with Scourge and this does work. Also has shred and gives you even more spirit resist so you're even tankier.

915014646.annotation: Great item once you have 2 actives. It also makes Torment Pulse tick faster!

1644605047.annotation: Great item and good in many lanes. And late game has good spirit scaling, and ends up being like a 500+ barrier.

1047818222.annotation: Good if you need debuff reduction and are going to build Spellbreaker later (good if they have heavy spirit burst such as Grey Talon or Lash).

1378931225.annotation: This since it got buffed is actually kinda really good against some characters, especially Haze and Drifter. I'd get this as an alternative to Bullet Resilience or Plated Armor. Good with trans CD

865958998.annotation: Alternative to Fortitude. Nice for rotating around the map, ganking, escaping/survivability, and the heal is great. At the moment I don't like this too much since it doesn't work in the tunnels.

1414025773.annotation: Great against certain characters and abilities. Especially Lash.

1144549437.annotation: Pretty good. If you're getting 3 1.6k gun items to get your 4.8k spike then this would be one of them usually.

2481177645.annotation: Great for 1v1s. Gets you your 4.8k weapon investment. Shadow Weave and Point Blank are also good options, or buy Mystic Shot + Spirit Shredder Bullets if you have the slots.

4075861416.annotation: Another option for your 4.8k weapon spike.

395944548.annotation: Great damage over the course of a game/fight. Good for tankiness and farming. Gets us our 4.8k spirit investment. I personally prefer it over Spirit Snatch as it does better in longer trades.

951866250.annotation: Feels nice, I usually get if I bought a barrier item earlier in the game.

1955841979.annotation: Incredible against Lash, Grey Talon, and any other spirit burst characters.

3491236900.annotation: Great but usually only buy once you already have bullet resist. Great against Haze.

1250307611.annotation: Great against gun carries and is good to pick up if you have no free slots.

630839635.annotation: TESTING/ Slash >Arctic >Bomb >Echo >Bomb, will do around 1k~ more dmg

1342610602.annotation: Worth going early now for Point Blank if you prefer that. Nice for melee resist as well. If you want to kill minions and objectives, its as good as Monster Rounds.

2447176615.annotation: Swap this out for Dispel Magic or a situational vitality 1.6k item most games. Great for move speed in fights and the slow resist. Lets you much more easily get the second ult damage proc off.

2407781327.annotation: Melee damadge and tankiness. Pick between this and Ethereal Shift for your last active slot.

3357231760.annotation: Really great in late teamfights. Especially good if you are really struggling against CC. Or for midboss.

3028234315.annotation: Kind of a meme item. Very situational. Only get against lots of incremental spirit damage (McGinnis turrets, Infernus, Warden Ult) and have Spirit Resilience already.

1371725689.annotation: Good for shutting down fliers and gun carries. And for getting on top of the people you need to target in team fights.

1710079648.annotation: Great for healing if you get really low in lane. Sprint speed is also nice for rotating. If you're going to buy one of these situational healing items, this one stays useful after laning phase.

1252627263.annotation: Tons of healing from your 2 and melees. Keeps you alive in fights. It's 200+ health heal on a 4 sec CD.

3633614685.annotation: Gets you your 4.8k vitality spike. You can build this into Fortitude or Colossus. You can buy this earlier during laning to help with survivability. If you went Dispel Magic already, skip this.

3585132399.annotation: The health is great for survivability, the move speed is great for rotating, and the heal lets you stay on the map longer. I prefer this over VW cause it works in the tunnels. Or go Dispel Magic here.

2163598980.annotation: If you need anti-spirit. Very common buy although not absolutely necessary since we build many items that have spirit resist already. Really strong at the moment.

3140772621.annotation: For bullet resist. If it's early, probably just go Battle Vest instead though. If it's late and you've got Transcendent Cooldown I would just go Metal Skin instead.

3970837787.annotation: Great for more spirit resist early. Cooldown reduction is really rare so this is a great item since it gives you some.

112198670.annotation: Great against spirit damage. You can get in some lanes.

2059712766.annotation: 10% spirit resist for 1.6k and the health and the stamina is really nice.

1925087134.annotation: Great at stopping gun carries. Easy to proc and can proc on many people.

2095565695.annotation: Feels pretty good. It is now fixed for your 2! Difficult on slots though. Good for melee resist if you need that.

1798666702.annotation: I think the stats from this are really good. The invisibility is bugged with cat form I think though, so just be wary of that. Hunter's Aura is usually better.

1396247347.annotation: Great for damage and ammo, replaces Stalker.

1282141666.annotation: Might be quite nice against tanks if you've gone into more gun late game.

3361811174.annotation: If you are actually like the only player on your team doing anything and you have like 65k souls you could get this.

334300056.annotation: fun item, good value, mmm mmmmovement. You could buy this in the mid game some time rather than getting resists perhaps.

3270001687.annotation: Good for movement and the bullet resist is nice.

2617435668.annotation: If you really need to screw over someone in particular.

2800629741.annotation: Fun and silly! Also good escape tool. Just worse to get than other 6ks though. Meme item.

2947183272.annotation: Kind of fun, but not very good. Adds up to a decent amount of heal in longer fights since Torment Pulse and Scourge easily procs it.

1254091416.annotation: If no one else on your team is going to buy this and you really need to stop a Vindicta/GT or Seven ult.

3144988365.annotation: I don't think this is really all that worth it compared to just getting Healbane. Since any person incredibly reliant on healing will just get Debuff Remover. But maybe get against Mo or Abrams.

1102081447.annotation: Just feels really nice, makes it super easy to hit your ults second/end damage burst.

1219329868.annotation: Builds into Focus Lens, easy to use and great for 1v1s. Makes your burst stronger.

1998374645.annotation: Your bombs can't really proc this anymore. So you can only proc it with Cold Front/Arctic Blast and your ult.

1235347618.annotation: The bullet resist and regen is great in lane. Later though you should just get Bullet Resilience. Also good for farming denizens.

3361075077.annotation: Good against Graves and gun carries.

805079544.annotation: It's nice, usually the other shields are better though in most games.

2226497419.annotation: If you're going more into gun later then this might be good.

709540378.annotation: Possible item for your 4.8k Weapon Investment, but imo it's not that necessary on Calico.

3403085434.annotation: Not as good since the speed stacking nerf. I still like it though. Good for movespeed in ult and catform. Combine with a 3.2k weapon item to get your 4.8k investment spike.
